messages:
Maya: kicking off a 10% canary for model v4.0-int8 now. target checks: semantic_similarity, clause_preservation, p99 latency. keeping composite_gate enabled but watching sensitive slice behavior.

deploy-bot: started canary -> v4.0-int8 @ 10% traffic. 20 pods allocated.

Lucas: pls capture A/B and slice breakdowns, especially legal_documents and contract_tables. any perf/throughput changes?

Maya: posting first 25m window (A=prod v3.9, B=v4.0-int8):
```
semantic_similarity: A=0.915, B=0.903 (\u0394=-0.012, -1.3%)
clause_preservation: A=0.978, B=0.956 (\u0394=-0.022, -2.2%)
p99 latency: A=240ms, B=140ms
cost_per_token: A=$0.0009, B=$0.0006 (-33%)
```

Priya: latency and cost look great but clause_preservation drop on contracts is concerning. legal teams will flag this.

Maya: composite_gate config (simplified):
```
rollout_gate:
  monitor_window: 30m
  composite_threshold: 0.02  # weighted sum of normalized deltas
  weights:
    semantic_similarity: 0.4
    clause_preservation: 0.45
    p99_latency: 0.15
  auto_rollback: true
```
We didn't hit composite_threshold because p99 improved a lot, masking the clause loss in the weighted sum.

Lucas: that's the problem with single-number gates. Sensitive slices get buried. can we add slice-level overrides?

Maya: eval-bot running targeted probe on 500 contract snippets now (table rows, numbered clauses, bullet lists). will post results.

eval-bot: targeted eval complete: clause_preservation on legal_documents: A=0.977, B=0.948 (\u0394=-0.029). Notable failures: dropped clause numbers, merged table rows into prose, introduced placeholder text for dates. samples attached in ML-4229.

Priya: urgent: require manual approval if clause_preservation drop > 0.01 for sensitive slice 'legal_documents'. Also add a short smoke harness for legal slices at canary start.

Maya: suggested config snippet to add to rollout policy (will PR):
```
slice_overrides:
  legal_documents:
    metric: clause_preservation
    absolute_drop_threshold: 0.01
    action: require_manual_approval
    smoke_test:
      prompts: 50
      must_pass: 48
```

Lucas: +1. also recommend adding a separate hallucination check for entity fidelity in tables (dates, amounts). even a small absolute failure is critical.

Maya: agreed. pausing canary and aborting traffic shift until PR merged and smoke tests pass.

deploy-bot: canary paused @ 10%. No further traffic shifted.

ai-safety: assigning incident ML-4229 to Maya and AI-safety. collect concrete counterexamples and create a reproducible unit test for the eval harness.

Maya: creating PR for slice overrides + smoke harness, and expanding contract eval corpus with adversarial table variants. will tag reviewers.

Priya: let's make slice override defaults more conservative for all models shipped to clients with legal/regulatory use cases. set policy in rollout cookbook.

Lucas: logging note: auto_rollback logic should surface per-slice contributions to composite score in the console to avoid surprises. filing infra ticket INF-879.

Maya: thanks everyone. aborting canary now and saving diffs to ML-4229. will follow up with timeline for re-run after new evals and PR merge.

Priya: :white_check_mark: keep me posted on PR and safety sign-off.
